_comment: one_persona_linear.json sized for a 24 GB card: the same experiment, run faster.
micro_batch_size 2 -> 5: the optimizer still steps once per 10 examples (batch_size unchanged), in 2 passes instead of 5.
eval batch sizes 4 -> 16: decision trials and report replies scored 16 prompts at a time. Evaluation at the base model
and each of the 12 checkpoints (every 250 of 3000 steps) is most of the run's time, so this is the main saving.
Gradient checkpointing stays on. Out of memory: first eval batches 8, then micro_batch_size 2.
Results match the 16 GB config up to floating-point noise from the different batch shapes, not bit for bit.
